requirements.contract: /tts focus toggles session-wide output overlays without changing TTS/narrate enablement or normal settings. Solo takes priority, then focus, then normal. Only local Pulse output is eligible.

Read, TTS, narration and choices share the same controller within one Pi bus, with no process-global focus flag or routing leaks to another session. Local native speech and Pulse-aware commands receive resolved options.
Missing focus sinks are created, existing ones reused; no focus sink is ever unloaded, including a solo sink promoted to focus.

Solo derives a bounded Pulse-safe session ID and human display label. Only positively owned null-sink modules can be removed, after validating marker/module/sink identity and no active inputs. Borrowed sinks and reused IDs are never unloaded.

Active/queued playback retains its route and holds solo cleanup until settlement. Mode changes affect new playback. Routing objects/secrets are not serialized into the machine queue. No normal startup runs pactl or restores temporary modes.

Pactl uses bounded explicit argv, selected-server routing, safe nested property quoting and module-ID readback. Lost replies are reconciled; ambiguous mutations are not blindly retried. Production Pulse state is untouched by validation.

validation.focused: 20 routing/ownership/command/surface/queue tests passed; real Pulse integration passed independently and in three consecutive private-server reruns
validation.full_suite: AG_TEST_BIN=$PWD/ag/target/debug/ag PI_RUN_PULSE_ROUTING_SMOKE=1 npm test: 1895 passed, 0 failed, 1 opt-in real-Pi smoke skipped
validation.checks: git diff --check and npm run check passed (workflow YAML syntax only; actionlint unavailable)
validation.native: Isolated PulseAudio 17 server, private Unix socket, no hardware modules: real pactl creation/reuse/ownership/quoted-label/lease cleanup passed. Operator Pulse graph and settings were not changed.
validation.rollout: Source integration only. Modes require explicit commands; no live focus or solo activation performed.
